factors.value_notes: Western North Atlantic tagging reports wide SST use but greatest capture association around 12–18 °C and common use around 10–22 °C; Southern California adult/subadult tags report 16–21 °C SST. Geography and prey-driven vertical behavior vary, so these sources partially support 12–24 °C / 15–20 °C but do not establish a South Florida catch curve.
